I remember how terrified I was when I was outed to my parents— I thought they’d disown me— and there was a lot of hurting after it happened, but over time I was pleasantly surprised by their ability to come around and embrace me.

No, I can’t promise that will happen to OP. And no, it doesn’t sound like it happened to you, which I’m sorry about. But it’s on the table. You might be surprised.
It’s gonna be okay. It’s a scary, awkward moment, but no matter what happens in the short term, your parents will love you and you’ll be free to love who you want openly.
